text: Le Rond Central (lerondcentral.fr), a sports-equipment shop that calls itself an official supplier of Stade Brestois 29, is published by SAS KERMASPORT (RCS Brest 489 019 547, 69 rue Amiral Romain-Desfosses, Brest). The company register lists KERHUPERT (SIREN 990088437, SARL) as Président de SAS of KERMASPORT, and Geoffrey Julien Louis Hubert and Marie-Bénédicte Claire Hubert (Pons) as the gérants of KERHUPERT.
short: Le Rond Central is published by Kermasport, whose Président is Kerhupert, managed by Geoffrey Hubert and Marie-Bénédicte Hubert.
